value.text: {"sql": "SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS day_cdt, HOUR(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS peak_hour_cdt, MAX(usgs_northport_peak_cfs) AS max_peak_cfs FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-18 06:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' GROUP BY day_cdt, peak_hour_cdt ORDER BY day_cdt, max_peak_cfs DESC LIMIT 200", "purpose": "Test whether USGS Northport peak hour is consistently 21:00 CDT across Oct 18–22, confirming scheduled hydropower releases"}
